description:
**Gap**
There is no visual indicator showing what is currently in the steering
or follow-up queue. Users press Enter while streaming, see their text
disappear into the transcript like a normal turn, and have no way to
distinguish \"sent\" from \"queued\".

**Upstream reference (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/modes/interactive/interactive-mode.ts)**
- updatePendingMessagesDisplay/0 (around L3527-3547) renders dim
  \"Steering: <text>\" and \"Follow-up: <text>\" lines plus a hint
  \"↳ <key> to edit all queued messages\" in a dedicated container
  above the editor.
- Triggered on every \"queue_update\" event emitted by AgentSession
  (_emit({ type: \"queue_update\", steering, followUp })).

**Octo_pi state**
- No pendingMessagesContainer equivalent in interactive.ex.
- Coder.Loop tracks pending messages indirectly via OctoPi.Agent's
  PendingMessageQueue but never emits a queue_update event.

**Fix sketch**
1. Add a queue_update event to OctoPi.Agent.Event (or to Coder's
   subscriber stream) emitted on every steer/follow_up enqueue and on
   every drain (so the UI sees the \"removed when delivered\" transition).
2. In octo_pi_tui interactive state, track {steering: [text], follow_up: [text]}
   and render dim \"Steering: …\" / \"Follow-up: …\" lines just above the
   input border, with the \"alt+up to edit queued messages\" hint.
title: [FEATURE] Pending-messages indicator (Steering / Follow-up) above editor
